items.situation: Going camping next weekend. I haven't hung out with my friends in so long.
On christmas morning last year, i got everything i wanted.
I've been stealing internet from my neighbors since I moved in. Kinda feel bad about it.
I miss my college days so much.
I graudated with a mechanical engineering degree in may.
i went into that interview last week ready for anything they threw at me
I was at the store and it was like I was the only one in there. I felt weird.
I start my new ob tomorrow. I am so nervous.
I forgot to put up the leftovers last night and ruined dinner for today.
I rejected an offer from a competitor company and wanted to stay in my current organisation out of loyalty

When I was in middle school, I remember seeing a question on the board and feeling positive that I knew the answer. When all was quiet and the teacher asked if anyone knew the answer, I confidently spoke up, only to be incorrect.
My brother got hurt badly and i felt so heartfelt for him.
I got a letter in the mail today from my cousin. He was overseas and thinking of me, it was a nice shock
I always donate my old things to the less fortunate rather than selling them.
I was anticipating the first day of school for a few days. It was going to be the first day in High school
My best friend beat my time in a race we ran. I tried for months and she decided to join on the spur of the moment.
I needed gas and didn't have cash. Some stranger paid for it without me even asking.
I'm really feeling good about my work evaluations and wishing for the best.

I just went for my yearly physical and thought everything was good, but I got a call that the doctor wanted to talk to me about some blood work. Its awful because they aren't open until tomorrow so they haven't gotten back to me yet.
I went to Wendy's and the cashier overcharged me! I was so upset about it.
I knew i would win the lotory.

It's raining right now after high humidity and heat in the UK which, while it isn't much compared to other countries, is short-lived so we don't have much time to acclimatise. I'm so happy it's cooling down.
My grandfather passed from medical malpractice a year ago.
My crush keeps hanging out with a new guy classmate a lot lately.
My neighbor got this fancy audi that i saw at the dealership, it must have cost 70k. Very nice car
I completely confide in my wife and children.
I worked all day and came home to the whole house a wreck. My husband had the whole month off and he didn't clean one bit of the house or make dinner.
My ex girlfriend cheated on me with one of my closest friends. It made me very angry at the both of them.
I went out to eat one time, and had a huge hair in my food. It was baked into a ravioli.
I felt pretty interested after hearing someone speak at church yesterday. They knew what they were talking about
I am finding it hard to let go of my old car.
I am upset because my friend just got a new house and I am still living in a 1 bedroom apartment.
my friend got promoted at reasors
I used to want more kids, but I think I'm happy with my family size for now.
I will be in a competition tomorrow and judging from the way other competitors look, i will certainly be the winner

I took my finals exam last week. I am optimistic about the results but we shall see.
I trust President Trump all the way.
